claim: Dreis (home of Waldhotel Sonnora) is in the Bernkastel-Wittlich district at the edge of the Wittlich Depression on the river Salm, belonging to the Verbandsgemeinde of Wittlich-Land.
quote: Dreis is an Ortsgemeinde – a municipality belonging to a Verbandsgemeinde... in the Bernkastel-Wittlich district in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. The municipality lies on the river Salm at the point where it flows out of the Eifel at the foot of the Burgberg, on the edge of the Wittlich Depression.

claim: Wild- und Erlebnispark Daun runs 15 Mar–14 Nov 10:00–18:00 (winter 10:00–16:00) with 2026 admission €18 adult, €16 child (4–15), family ticket €60, and offers an 8-km car safari, falconry, monkey canyon, adventure playground and summer toboggan run.
quote: Erwachsene: 18,00 € · Kinder (4-15 Jahre): 16,00 € · Familienpaket (2 Erw. + 2 Kinder): 60,00 €

claim: Wildpark Daun spans roughly 250 hectares of forest and meadow with native wildlife observable along a car safari, plus an adventure playground and summer toboggan (extra charge).
quote: approximately 250 hectares of forest and meadow terrain with numerous mostly native wildlife species... 8-kilometer car safari route and various attractions including a bird of prey enclosure, a barbary macaque gorge, an adventure playground, and a summer toboggan run

claim: Bitburger Erlebniswelt brewery tour in Bitburg runs ~1 hour with bookings required; €9 adults (16+), €5 ages 12–15, free under 12, including two drinks and a pretzel bar in the Bit-Lounge.
quote: Admission costs €9 for adults aged 16 and over. Children from 12 to 15 years pay €5.00. Children under 12 years have free admission. This includes the guided tour as well as two free drinks and a pretzel bar in the Bit Lounge.

claim: Cochemer Sesselbahn chairlift operates 28 Mar–15 Nov 2026 with 2026 fares of €5.90/€7.90 (adult single/return), €2.90/€3.90 (child 4–14), and a family card €20 return for up to 4 children.
quote: Children (4-14 years) €2.90 / €3.90 · Adults (14+) €5.90 / €7.90 · Family card (2-4 children) €20.00

claim: Cochem lies ~26.6 km as the crow flies from Wittlich, placing it at the outer edge of a 30-km radius from Dreis (which sits south of Wittlich).
quote: The shortest distance between Cochem and Wittlich is 26.57 km as the crow flies.

claim: The Naturfreibad Schalkenmehrener Maar (near Daun) opens 1 Jun–14 Sep 2026 from 10:00–19:00 with a baby pool, toddler pool, diving board and water slide; entry €5 adult, €3 child 4–17, free under 4.
quote: Adult admission is €5.00, children aged 4-17 cost €3.00, and children up to 3 years have free entry... open from June 1, 2026 to September 14, 2026, from 10:00–19:00.

claim: The Maarmuseum in Manderscheid uses interactive media to tell the volcanic maar story, with a 45-million-year-old Eckfeld primeval-horse skeleton, climbing-volcano playground and zip line; €3 adult / €2 child, combi ticket with Niederburg €3.50.
quote: Maarmuseum Manderscheid... The highlight is the 'Eckfelder Urpferdchen,' an almost completely preserved skeleton of a pregnant mare from 45 million years ago... features a playground with a climbing volcano and zip line. Admission is €3.00 for adults and €2.00 for children ages 4-17

claim: Manderscheid's twin castles — the Niederburg (paid, daily 11:00–17:00 Apr–Nov, €2 adult / €0.70 child) and the freely accessible Oberburg ruin — sit ~15 km from Dreis and add a low-cost, hands-on medieval stop to a Maarmuseum visit.
quote: The Niederburg can be visited daily from April to November between 11:00 and 17:00. The Oberburg can be visited free of charge daily. Admission to the Niederburg costs €2.00 for adults and €0.70 for children aged 5-15

claim: Eifelpark Gondorf (8 km east of Bitburg) opens for the 2026 main season on 28 March with day tickets €37.50 (≥150 cm), €34.50 (105–149 cm), free under 105 cm; afternoon 'Schnupperrunde' from 15:30 is €20.
quote: Visitors 150cm and taller: €37.50 · Visitors 105-149cm: €34.50 · Children under 105cm: Free · Schnupperrunde (afternoon entry after 3:30 PM): €20.00 · gültig ab 28.03.2026

claim: Eifelpark Gondorf combines a wildlife park with about 60 rides including a summer toboggan, rapids ride and roller-coaster, sitting roughly 8 km east of Bitburg.
quote: Der Eifelpark bietet 60 Attraktionen und viele Wildtiere, darunter eine Sommerrodelbahn, Wildwasserbahn und Achterbahn... Eifelpark ist 8 km östlich von Bitburg

claim: The Burg Landshut Express — a vintage yellow shuttle bus, not a chairlift — runs hourly daily Apr–Oct from Am Gestade in Bernkastel up to the Landshut castle ruin above the Mosel meander.
quote: The 'Burg-Landshut Express' runs daily from 11:00 - 17:00 on the hour (from April to October). It departs hourly from 10 to 18 Uhr from the stop 'Am Gestade'... bright yellow Burg Landshut Express brings you quickly and reliably to the gates of Landshut Castle

claim: Bowling Room Trier (Franz-Georg-Straße 125, Trier) bundles modern bowling lanes, laser tag and arcade with food and bar service, open Wed–Thu 17:00–22:00, Fri–Sat to 01:00 and Sun 11:00–21:00 — the nearest one-stop indoor entertainment center to Dreis since Wittlich itself lacks an equivalent.
quote: Bowlingroom Trier is the address for laser tag, arcade games and bowling in Trier... closed Monday and Tuesday, open 5:00 PM - 10:00 PM Wednesday and Thursday, 5:00 PM - 1:00 AM Friday and Saturday, and 11:00 AM - 9:00 PM Sunday

claim: Only eight ferries still cross the Mosel; within day-trip range from Dreis the Alf–Bullay 'Remigius' (passenger/bike, sub-5-minute crossing) is the most accessible novelty stop, while the car-and-passenger 'St. Josef' Ellenz-Poltersdorf–Beilstein cable ferry runs daily in season.
quote: Remigius (Alf–Bullay): Passenger and bicycle ferry... Small ferry taking under five minutes; cars must use the nearby bridge... St. Josef (Ellenz-Poltersdorf–Beilstein): Car and passenger ferry... Motor-assisted cable ferry operating daily during tourist season

claim: Vulkaneifel-Therme in Bad Bertrich (Germany's only Glauber's-salt thermal spring, 32 °C) is the closest true thermal spa to Dreis, but in 2026 the steam bath is under renovation from 8 Jun to early September and the full therme closes 15–28 Jun for maintenance.
quote: The Vulkaneifel Therme will be closed from June 15-28, 2026 for cleaning and maintenance work. Additionally, the steam bath will be renovated starting June 8, 2026 until early September 2026

claim: Eifel-Therme Zikkurat — often paired with Bitburg in listings — is actually in Mechernich (North Rhine-Westphalia), well over 60 km from Dreis and outside a 30-km radius despite its 'Eifel' branding.
